text:
jamal: Quick heads-up — ran the nightly region sweep comparing H100 vs A100 for 65B q4f16 (30k-token cap tests, 30s context). Raw CSV + dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/bench/3112

anya: Nice. what's the p99 / sustained req/s per GPU? we need numbers for Dedicated sizing (EU + US peaks).

jamal: Putting the short table here (per-GPU observed under steady synthetic load):
```
H100 (65B q4f16, 30s ctx): p50=28ms, p95=140ms, p99=320ms, steady throughput=18 req/s (1k token gen)
A100 (65B q4f16, 30s ctx): p50=38ms, p95=180ms, p99=420ms, steady throughput=13 req/s (1k token gen)
```

maria: ok. our SLO target is 95% < 250ms right? looks like H100 meets p95 but p99 is above. need headroom calc.

jamal: right. quick sizing calc (target util=75% to leave runway + batching jitter):
- formula: GPUs = ceil(peak_rps / (per_gpu_throughput * target_util))
- EU peak = 250 req/s, US peak = 400 req/s (observed 99th percentile of traffic windows)

Calculations:
```
EU (H100): ceil(250 / (18 * 0.75)) = ceil(250 / 13.5) = 19 GPUs
EU (A100): ceil(250 / (13 * 0.75)) = ceil(250 / 9.75) = 26 GPUs
US (H100): ceil(400 / 13.5) = 30 GPUs
US (A100): ceil(400 / 9.75) = 42 GPUs
```

anya: those are raw minimums. recommend a mixed-pool for cost: assume 60% H100 / 40% A100 in each region (price delta ~1.8x). That gives effective capacity per region:
```
EU mixed: 0.6*19 + 0.4*26 ≈ 11.4 + 10.4 = 22 GPUs -> round up to 23
US mixed: 0.6*30 + 0.4*42 ≈ 18 + 16.8 = 35 GPUs -> 35
```

maria: +1) add autoscale headroom for microbursts. I vote +30% buffer for night/weekend spikes and rollout flakiness.

jamal: applying +30%:
```
EU mixed w/headroom: 23 * 1.3 = 29.9 -> 30 GPUs
US mixed w/headroom: 35 * 1.3 = 45.5 -> 46 GPUs
```

ops: note: warm-start / KV cache can cut p99 by ~25% if we prewarm common prefixes. but prewarming costs tokens and delayed autoscale. tradeoff to discuss.

anya: good point. if we model a 20% effective throughput improvement from warm cache (for chatty workloads) we can shave GPUs by ~20%. jamal — can you run a sim with traffic mix (chatty vs one-shot) and include prewarm cost?

jamal: yep — I'll run the per-AZ sims tonight and include 3 mixes (100% one-shot, 70/30 chat/one-shot, 100% chat). will post results + updated dashboard CSV.

sre-bot: autoscaler triggered scale up +5 in us-west2 at 02:14 UTC during the test window. Logged as evt-3112233489.

maria: action items:
- jamal: run sims + post per-AZ numbers + CSV (ETA tomorrow morning)
- anya: bake these numbers into the Dedicated sizing doc and include cost delta table (H100 vs mixed)
- ops: prototype a light prewarm job and measure token cost vs p99 improvement

anya: thanks — this is enough to start the capacity request for Q2 runway. we'll keep the pool targets flexible until sim results are in. :thumbsup:

jamal: adding a quick note: kernel choice mattereds for tail latency — we saw fp16 aten kernels slightly better for p99 on H100, but q4f16 optimized kernels on A100 reduced variance. I'll include kernel flags in the sim output.

ops: FYI i'll coordinate AZ distribution to avoid single-AZ exhaust if we land on small odd counts.

maria: perfect. ping me when CSV is up.

jamal: will do.
